text:
erin: Requesting quiet window for AstraNova Health dedicated migration. Customer needs model pinned to v3.0.0-8bit and runtime-image redwood/runtime:2026-04-02-prod for parity with their validation lab. Proposed window: 2026-04-10 01:00-03:00 UTC (Sat).
frank: Heads-up: LHR-dedicated cluster has capacity but we need a slice reservation + HSM key access check. I'll open reservation and verify KMS permissions.
gina: Please include a prewarm step and token-prefix flush. Last time we saw a KV cache mismatch that doubled tail latency.
harry: Can we do 10% canary for 20m, then 30% for 15m, then 100% ramp if green? Manual gate at 30% requested by customer.
ivy: CS confirms customer prefers manual signoff after the 30% hold. They also want a post-rollout smoke check on 10 example prompts saved in s3://an-release/smokes.json.
erin: Runbook outline: 1) Reserve slice + confirm HSM access 2) prewarm priming job 3) deploy v3.0.0-8bit to canary slice 4) run synthetics & correctness checks 5) manual signoff at 30% 6) ramp to 100% 7) post-rollout smoke check + release note.
frank: Reservation created: slice-21 in LHR reserved 2026-04-10T01:00Z-03:30Z (buffer included). Reservation ID: R-94211.
deploybot: priming job queued id=592334 for tenant astranova slice=21 model=v3.0.0-8bit. ETA 8m.
frank: Priming started. snippet: `priming: 80/80 samples processed, avg latency 52ms, tok_coverage 95%`
gina: Suggested rollback gates: any 5m window with error-rate > 1.2% above baseline OR p95 > 2x baseline OR inference mismatch rate > 0.8% on correctness checks -> rollback. Also immediate rollback on HSM failures.
ivy: I'll notify customer contacts and request they stand by for manual signoff at 30%. They want CS on the call at 01:45 UTC.
erin: Pinning details: model: v3.0.0-8bit, runtime: redwood/runtime:2026-04-02-prod, commit: be4c1f2. Note: this build includes quantization fixes for tokenization alignment.
harry: Quick deploy command for canary (for runbook):
```
deploybot deploy --tenant astranova --slice 21 --model v3.0.0-8bit --traffic 10% --runtime redwood/runtime:2026-04-02-prod
```
frank: HSM key check: IAM role astranova-hsm-access present and can decrypt sample blob. Verified.
deploybot: Canary deploy job 592345 scheduled. ETA 12m.
ivy: CS: approved for window, will confirm customer on-call numbers and signoff plan. :white_check_mark:
frank: Infra: approved for reservation and priming. :thumbsup:
gina: SRE: approved for canary + monitoring hooks. I added hooks for correctness checks and trace sampling. :ok_hand:
harry: Release manager: approved, will file release note entry after completion.
billing-bot: Billing note created: Migrate astranova to v3.0.0-8bit during reserved window R-94211. Ticket B-77821.
erin: Rollback command for runbook (emergency):
```
deploybot rollback --tenant astranova --slice 21 --to-model v2.9.7 --force
```
ivy: Customer requires post-migration validation: run 10 smoke prompts, check parity >= 98% with lab results. I'll post results here when done.
harry: Any objections to the window? Please respond approve/hold within 30m.
frank: approve
gina: approve
ivy: approve (CS will confirm manual signoff live)
erin: Locking window and posting runbook to #eng-oncall 1h before. I'll ping customer and add meeting link.
deploybot: Created release note RN-2026-04-10-astranova and attached to ticket B-77821.
